id: 01_Preventing Contamination in the Lab - [Laboratory Safety Training Video]
title: 看不见的污染：实验室防污染
source_doc: course/Fire Safety & Extinguisher Training/01_Preventing Contamination in the Lab - [Laboratory Safety Training Video].md
author_source: project/Fire Safety & Extinguisher Training/01_Preventing Contamination in the Lab - [Laboratory Safety Training Video]/src.py

points.K4: 先读标签和安全数据单
points.K8: 最低配置：手套、实验服、护目镜
points.K10: 预判危害，问清所需防护
points.K11: 防护用品坏了脏了就换
points.K21: 不穿实验服、不戴手套出门
points.K23: 污染物与清洁物不混放
points.K26: 用后去污，共用设备更要清洁

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁的实验台旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a tidy lab bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室里看不见的污染。
overlay: 看不见的污染：实验室防污染

shots.scene: 手套、实验服、通风柜、洗手池四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a pair of gloves, a lab coat, a fume hood and a hand washing sink. No people.
shots.narration: 管住手、管住物、管住门。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着手套做完实验，顺手拿起手机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, still wearing lab gloves after an experiment, picks up his smartphone from the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完实验，戴着手套就拿手机。

shots.scene: 紫光灯下，手机、阿杰的脸颊和记录本上出现发光斑点
shots.prompt_en: Under purple ultraviolet light, glowing spots appear on the smartphone, the young male student's cheek and a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 荧光一照，到处都是发光的斑点。

shots.scene: 阿杰吃惊地看着自己的手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at his glowing gloves in surprise.
shots.narration: 他吓了一跳：这些都是我带过去的？

shots.scene: 小研递给他一副新手套，指向洗手池
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a new pair of gloves and points toward the hand washing sink.
shots.narration: 小研说：污染就是这样悄悄传开的。

shots.scene: 台面上的毒物、腐蚀品、致癌物图标瓶子
shots.prompt_en: Three blank bottles on a bench with a skull pictogram, a corrosion pictogram and a health hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 毒物、腐蚀品、致癌物，天天会碰到。

shots.scene: 瓶子周围扩散出一圈圈污点，波及小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Faint stains spread in rings from a bottle across the bench toward two small person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 不加控制，危害就会扩散到身边。

shots.scene: 欣欣把一只瓶子放进托盘，神情认真
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot carefully places a bottle into a spill tray with a serious face.
shots.narration: 伤到的可能是你，也可能是同事。

shots.scene: 试管外壁挂着一滴液体，戴手套的手握住试管
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds a test tube with a small drop of liquid on its outer wall. No faces.
shots.narration: 一滴挂在试管外壁的液体，

shots.scene: 箭头从试管到手套，再到门把手、电话、记录本
shots.prompt_en: Arrows lead from a test tube to a glove, then to a doorknob, a telephone and a blank notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 经过手套，传到你摸过的每样东西。

shots.scene: 几个无意识动作图标：扶眼镜、摸脸、接电话
shots.prompt_en: Three small icons: a hand adjusting glasses, a hand touching a face and a hand holding a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 几个下意识的动作，就能把它带走。

shots.scene: 欣欣蹲下用放大镜看台面
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot crouches and looks at the bench surface through a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 污染这么容易发生，就要处处预防。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶和戴手套的手两个图标，中间一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a reagent bottle and a gloved hand with a green check mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 用什么物质、怎么操作，都要上心。

shots.section_title: 先读标签和安全数据单
shots.scene: 小研翻阅一本空白的安全数据单和试剂瓶上的图形标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet binder next to a bottle with hazard pictogram labels.
shots.narration: 用一种物质前，先读标签和安全数据单。
overlay: 先读标签和安全数据单

shots.section_title: 先读标签和安全数据单
shots.scene: 安全数据单图标旁浮现危害和防护两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document icon with a warning triangle icon and a glove icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 上面写着它有什么危害、怎么防护。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上标出鼻、眼、皮肤、嘴四处
shots.prompt_en: A simple human outline with four highlighted spots: nose, eyes, skin of the hand and mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 危险物质进入人体有四条路。

shots.scene: 鼻子吸入气体和眼睛被溅的两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a nose breathing in a vapor cloud, and an eye with a splash droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 吸入蒸气，或者溅进眼睛；

shots.scene: 皮肤沾液和针头刺入手指、嘴边食物的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a liquid drop on skin, a needle tip near a fingertip, and food near a mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤沾上、被扎破，或者吃进嘴里。

shots.scene: 三面盾牌依次排开
shots.prompt_en: Three shields in a row with icons: protective gear, a fume hood, and a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 守住这些路，靠三道防线一起用。

shots.scene: 王老师拿起护目镜对光检查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds safety goggles up to the light and inspects them.
shots.narration: 防护用品穿戴之前，先检查。

shots.scene: 破了口的手套被红叉划掉，完好的手套打勾
shots.prompt_en: A torn glove crossed out with a red X next to an intact glove with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 破了、坏了的，换新的。

shots.scene: 小研拉紧袖口，调整护目镜松紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts the strap of her safety goggles and the cuffs of her lab coat.
shots.narration: 还要大小合身，戴得服帖。

shots.section_title: 最低配置：手套、实验服、护目镜
shots.scene: 小研穿着实验服、戴护目镜和手套站好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in a buttoned lab coat with safety goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 最起码：手套、实验服、护目镜。
overlay: 最低配置：手套、实验服、护目镜

shots.scene: 老周在护目镜外再戴上面屏
shots.prompt_en: The older man puts on a clear face shield over his safety goggles.
shots.narration: 可能溅到头面颈部，再加一面屏。

shots.section_title: 预判危害，问清所需防护
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白的实验方案请教老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shows a blank experiment plan to the older man and asks a question.
shots.narration: 先想清楚这次实验有哪些危害。
overlay: 预判危害，问清所需防护

shots.section_title: 预判危害，问清所需防护
shots.scene: 老周指着防护用品架上的物品
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at a shelf of protective gear: gloves, goggles, face shields and lab coats.
shots.narration: 问清导师，该戴的一样不少。

shots.section_title: 防护用品坏了脏了就换
shots.scene: 时钟图标旁，手套出现污点后被换掉
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a glove that gets a stain, then an arrow to a fresh glove. No people.
shots.narration: 一整天都要留意防护用品的状况。
overlay: 防护用品坏了脏了就换

shots.section_title: 防护用品坏了脏了就换
shots.scene: 沾污的实验服袖口被红圈标出
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat sleeve with a stain circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 破了或可能被污染，马上更换。

shots.scene: 手套剖面：内侧汗珠，外侧液滴渗入
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway glove icon with sweat drops inside and liquid drops seeping in from outside. No people.
shots.narration: 里面出汗、外面沾液，手套会被渗透。

shots.scene: 湿手套被丢进废物桶，换上新手套
shots.prompt_en: A wet glove is dropped into a waste bin and a hand pulls on a fresh glove. No faces.
shots.narration: 手套一湿，立刻更换。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和手套盒
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a box of disposable gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 平时也要按规程定期更换。

shots.scene: 防溅挡板挡住飞溅的液滴
shots.prompt_en: A clear splash guard on a bench blocks flying droplets from a flask. No people.
shots.narration: 防溅挡板和防护屏，挡住意外飞溅。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里操作，箭头示意蒸气被抽走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a fume hood with the sash lowered; arrows show vapor drawn up and away.
shots.narration: 通风柜把蒸气挡在呼吸带之外。

shots.scene: 老周带阿杰认识实验室里的通风设施
shots.prompt_en: The older man shows the young male student the fume hood and the ventilation ducts in the lab.
shots.narration: 本实验室有哪些设施，问清楚、用起来。

shots.scene: 整洁的实验台，只摆当前要用的小瓶
shots.prompt_en: A neat lab bench holding only a few small bottles and a tray. No people.
shots.narration: 安全规范，从良好内务开始。

shots.scene: 杂乱台面被红叉划掉，整齐台面打勾
shots.prompt_en: A cluttered bench icon crossed out with a red X next to a tidy bench icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 台面整洁，不堆杂物。

shots.scene: 大瓶图标变成小瓶图标的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a large bottle icon to a small bottle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 能用小容器，就用小容器。

shots.scene: 小研把试剂瓶放回试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts a reagent bottle back on a labeled shelf in a chemical cabinet; labels are blank.
shots.narration: 不用的试剂，及时放回原处。

shots.scene: 吸附垫盖住台面上的一小摊液体
shots.prompt_en: An absorbent pad covers a small puddle of liquid on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒了，尽快清理。

shots.scene: 清理物放进废物袋，台面被擦拭干净
shots.prompt_en: Used absorbent pads go into a waste bag, and the bench is wiped clean. No faces.
shots.narration: 按规定处置，再把那块地方去污。

shots.scene: 阿杰下班前擦拭天平
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes the inside of a balance before leaving for the day.
shots.narration: 设备用完，当天清洁去污。

shots.scene: 空着的天平旁，下一位使用者的问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A clean balance with a question mark icon above it, suggesting the next user. No people.
shots.narration: 你不知道下一个用它的人是谁。

shots.scene: 水槽里玻璃器皿泡在肥皂水中
shots.prompt_en: Glassware soaking in a basin of soapy water in a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 器皿来不及洗，先泡在肥皂水里。

shots.scene: 泡过的器皿闪亮干净
shots.prompt_en: Clean shiny glassware on a drying rack. No people.
shots.narration: 少些污染，也更好洗。

shots.scene: 小研在开始实验前，把废物桶摆到台边
shots.prompt_en: Before starting work, the female graduate student places labeled-blank waste containers beside her bench.
shots.narration: 动手之前，先想好废物怎么处置。

shots.scene: 王老师手里拿着空白的规章制度册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank rules booklet.
shots.narration: 按实验室的书面规定执行。

shots.scene: 试剂倒入水槽的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker pouring liquid into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 下水道处理不了实验室化学品。

shots.scene: 地下管道通向河流和水龙头的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of underground pipes leading to a river and a drinking water tap, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 倒错一次，可能污染水源和环境。

shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师请教废液去向
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator a question while holding a closed waste bottle.
shots.narration: 不确定，就问导师和安全管理员。

shots.scene: 笔记本、笔、手机被一条虚线圈在实验室里
shots.prompt_en: A dashed line encloses a blank notebook, a pen and a phone inside a lab room icon. No people.
shots.narration: 休息、吃饭、回家，污染可能跟着走。

shots.scene: 记录本和笔留在实验台上，阿杰空手离开
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook and a pen stay on the bench as the young male student walks away empty-handed.
shots.narration: 实验用的本子和笔，留在实验室。

shots.scene: 工作中用过的东西都蒙上淡淡的污点图标
shots.prompt_en: Lab items used during work, a pen, a notebook and a marker, shown with faint stain icons. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的东西，都当它已被污染。

shots.scene: 小研在洗手池认真搓洗双手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands thoroughly at the sink with soap.
shots.narration: 离开工作区之前，彻底洗手。

shots.section_title: 不穿实验服、不戴手套出门
shots.scene: 穿实验服戴手套走出门的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person in a lab coat and gloves walking out of a door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服和手套，不能穿出实验室。
overlay: 不穿实验服、不戴手套出门

shots.section_title: 不穿实验服、不戴手套出门
shots.scene: 门把手上留下污点，下一只手伸过来
shots.prompt_en: A doorknob with a faint stain, and another bare hand reaching for it. No faces.
shots.narration: 手套碰过门把手，下一个人就沾上了。

shots.scene: 记录本放在午餐盒旁的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank notebook lying next to a sandwich, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 把实验记录带去吃饭，食物就可能被污染。

shots.scene: 禁止饮食标志
shots.prompt_en: A no eating or drinking sign on a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 实验区内不带食物和饮料。

shots.scene: 在实验水槽洗水杯的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a coffee mug being washed in a lab sink, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不在实验室水槽洗杯子和餐具。

shots.section_title: 污染物与清洁物不混放
shots.scene: 左边污染区、右边清洁区，中间一道线
shots.prompt_en: A bench divided by a line: a contaminated zone with a stain icon on the left and a clean zone with a sparkle icon on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 污染的东西和干净的东西，绝不混放。
overlay: 污染物与清洁物不混放

shots.scene: 戴手套的手伸向脸的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gloved hand reaching toward a face, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 污染会从手跑到脸上、嘴边。

shots.scene: 阿杰想揉鼻子，又把手放下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts to rub his nose, then stops and lowers his gloved hand.
shots.narration: 别揉脸、别挠鼻子，管住小动作。

shots.scene: 样品瓶里落进一个问号图标，旁边读数表指针乱跳
shots.prompt_en: A sample vial with a question mark icon falling in, next to a gauge with a jittering needle. No people.
shots.narration: 样品混进杂质，结果就会出错。

shots.scene: 小研在开始前、中途、结束后检查台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks and wipes her bench surface; three small clock icons float above.
shots.narration: 台面和设备，前中后都检查清洁。

shots.section_title: 用后去污，共用设备更要清洁
shots.scene: 老李按清单对仪器逐项去污
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wipes down a lab instrument while following a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 用完的设备，按程序彻底去污。
overlay: 用后去污，共用设备更要清洁

shots.section_title: 用后去污，共用设备更要清洁
shots.scene: 共用的加热搅拌器上留着残渍
shots.prompt_en: A shared hot plate stirrer with old residue stains on its top plate. No people.
shots.narration: 共用的加热板、搅拌器最容易积残留。

shots.section_title: 用后去污，共用设备更要清洁
shots.scene: 残留飘向另一位使用者的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show residue from the hot plate drifting into another user's beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 这些残留，会混进下一个人的实验。

shots.scene: 用气枪吹粉末的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an air gun blowing powder across a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 清理粉末，别用气枪吹。

shots.scene: 粉末飘散到别的台面和人身上
shots.prompt_en: A cloud of powder drifting across the room toward other benches and small person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 一吹就飘满屋子，污染别人。

shots.scene: 小研用湿润的吸附纸轻轻覆盖粉末再收起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves gently covers spilled powder with a damp absorbent pad and lifts it into a waste bag.
shots.narration: 轻轻覆盖收起，避免扬尘。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起五根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up five fingers in front of a blank board.
shots.narration: 防污染，记住五件事。

shots.scene: 五个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Five icons light up one by one: a document, gloves, a fume hood, a broom, and a hand with care. No people.
shots.narration: 知物质、穿防护、用工程控制。

shots.scene: 整洁台面与专注工作的小研
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works carefully at a tidy bench.
shots.narration: 保持整洁，小心工作，不想当然。

shots.scene: 小研擦净台面，阿杰随后接手使用
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student finishes wiping the bench clean; the young male student arrives to use it next.
shots.narration: 体谅前一个人，照顾下一个人。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室讲课，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先培训考核。

shots.scene: 小研和老周填写空白的风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man fill out a blank risk assessment form together.
shots.narration: 新实验先做风险评估，再定防护。

shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层图标
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked building icons: a university, a school building and a lab room. No people.
shots.narration: 学校、学院、实验室，层层有人负责。

shots.scene: 脱手套：一只手捏住另一只手套的外侧翻下
shots.prompt_en: Step icons: a gloved hand pinches the outside of the other glove and peels it off inside out. No people.
shots.narration: 脱手套，捏外侧，里朝外翻下。

shots.scene: 脱下的手套进废物桶，然后洗手
shots.prompt_en: Removed gloves go into a waste bin, followed by a hand washing icon. No people.
shots.narration: 脱完马上洗手。

shots.scene: 实验服挂在门边专用挂钩上
shots.prompt_en: Lab coats hang on dedicated hooks by the lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服挂在实验室专区。

shots.scene: 实验服放进家用洗衣机的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab coat going into a home washing machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不带回家洗，按规定统一清洗。

shots.scene: 实验冰箱里放饮料的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drink can inside a lab refrigerator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验冰箱，绝不放食物和饮料。

shots.scene: 用烧杯喝水的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker used as a drinking cup, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用实验器皿盛食物、喝水。

shots.scene: 禁止吸烟标志和化妆品图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: A no smoking sign next to a lipstick icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吸烟、不化妆。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验室外的休息区喝水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student drinks water from his own bottle in a break room outside the lab.
shots.narration: 要吃要喝，洗手后到指定区域。

shots.scene: 几个废物桶并排，各有不同图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of waste containers with different pictograms: a flask, a needle, a biohazard symbol and a recycling icon. No people.
shots.narration: 实验废物，分类收集。

shots.scene: 小研给废液桶贴空白标签，盖紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student attaches a blank label to a waste container and closes the lid tightly.
shots.narration: 贴好标签，盖紧，放在暂存点。

shots.scene: 老李把废物交给专门的收集人员
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands sealed waste containers over at a collection point.
shots.narration: 统一交给有资质的单位处置。

shots.scene: 台面上一小摊液体和一大片液体两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a small spill on a bench and a large spill spreading across the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒要先判断大小和危害。

shots.scene: 小研戴好防护，用溢洒处理包清理小量溢洒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves uses a spill kit to absorb a small spill on a bench.
shots.narration: 少量已知的，穿好防护自己处理。

shots.scene: 众人撤离，门口拉起警示带
shots.prompt_en: Students walk out of the lab and a warning tape is placed across the doorway.
shots.narration: 量大或不明，先撤离，再报告。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋标志和喷淋装置
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign above a lab safety shower. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品沾到皮肤，立刻大量冲水。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和正在出水的洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above an eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，马上到洗眼器冲洗。

shots.scene: 沾污的衣物被脱下放进袋子
shots.prompt_en: A contaminated lab coat is taken off and placed in a sealed bag. No faces.
shots.narration: 脱掉被污染的衣物。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字和数字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 需要就医及时就医，紧急拨打120。

shots.scene: 小研打电话向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the older man on the phone to report an incident.
shots.narration: 溢洒、沾染，都要及时报告。

shots.scene: 老周和王老师一起登记空白记录表
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator fill out a blank incident record together.
shots.narration: 报告导师和学院，如实记录原因。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现安全数据单、手套和通风柜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a document, gloves and a fume hood.
shots.narration: 先读资料，穿好防护，用好通风柜。

shots.scene: 整洁台面、溢洒包和分类废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tidy bench, a spill kit and sorted waste containers. No people.
shots.narration: 台面整洁，及时清理，废物分类。

shots.scene: 洗手、禁止饮食、门把手打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of hand washing, a no eating or drinking sign, and a doorknob with a glove crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 洗手离开，不饮食，不带污染出门。

shots.scene: 洗眼器、电话和记录本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eyewash station, a telephone and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 沾染先冲洗，事后要报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在擦得干干净净的实验台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a spotless lab bench.
shots.narration: 干干净净做实验，下次见！
